name: Róisín the Cyclist

intro.text: I'm cycling the Wild Atlantic Way, all two and a half thousand kilometres of it, Donegal to Cork. Day three. Legs gone. Battle me while I sit down.

win: Grand. That's my rest stop over. Only two thousand four hundred kilometres to go.
after: The Wild Atlantic Way starts up in Inishowen and runs right down the west coast. It's mostly uphill. Into the wind. Both ways.
